schemaUri.title: Schema Uri
schemaUri.description: The path to the DFDL schema file.

rootElement.title: Root Element
rootElement.description: The root element name of the schema to use. If not specified, the first root element in the schema will be used.

rootNamespace.title: Root Namespace
rootNamespace.description: The root namespace of the schema to use.

title: DFDL
description: Transforms fixed format data such as EDI message from/to XML using a Data Format Description Language (DFDL).
